title: Unit-economics efficiency initiative: tracking hypotheses and delivery roadmap
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Program-level tracking ticket that coordinates cross-functional work to reduce per-token inference cost across high-volume endpoints. Focus areas: smarter batching, prefix/KV cache improvements, and targeted quantization profiles. This ticket captures hypotheses, experiments, rollout strategy, OKR mapping, and the roadmap for the next three cycles.
updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff with ENG, Design, and SRE. Agreed on success metrics and initial experiment slate. See kickoff notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COGS/Unit+Econ+Kickoff
2026-02-22: Handoff to ENG leads. ENG identified kernel scheduling as blocker for aggressive batching on long-context requests; created ENG-2310.
2026-03-01: Design provided low-friction UX for enabling per-route caching in Console (DES-310). Prototype validated in internal demo.
2026-03-05: Data team analysis (Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcExample) shows top 20 routes account for 68% of token spend — prioritized for batching/caching experiments.

2026-03-09: Decided to A/B test KV cache-enabled variant on a subset of hosted customers and a dedicated capacity pool for predictable results. Product decision doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COGS/KV+Cache+A-B+Plan
2026-03-12: Created experiment dashboards in Datadog and Redwood Console runbooks for rollback criteria: https://app.datadog.com/dashboard/xyz and https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/unit-econ
2026-03-14: Blocker cleared for quantization pipeline (ENG-2405) — will enable 8-bit profile trials in Cycle 2026-W12. Noted potential model-quality regressions; Eval harness prepared.
acceptance_criteria: Establish a baseline dashboard with per-route token cost and latency for top 50 routes
Deploy KV cache on 10 high-spend routes and demonstrate >=12% token-cost reduction without >5% latency regression
Enable batching heuristics for short-chat workloads and show 15-25% cost improvement on P95 throughput windows
Run quantization profile on 3 representative models with quality checks (automated evals) and confirm no critical QA regressions
Document rollout runbook and automatic rollback triggers in Console; update customer-facing FAQ
risks: Quality regressions from quantization causing customer-facing hallucinations or lower relevance
Latency spikes from mis-tuned batching leading to SLA breaches
Inaccurate cost attribution (billing) during A/B windows complicating ROI calculations
Coordination delays between serving runtime and dedicated capacity on-boarding
decisions: Prioritize KV cache rollout for high-reuse chat routes before broad quantization — lower risk to output quality
Run Dedicated pool A/B alongside Hosted variant to measure both economic and capacity isolation effects
Use model-version pinning during experiments to control for upstream model changes
Require automated eval pass for each quantization profile before enabling in production
work_items: Experiment 1: KV cache on top-10 routes (ENG-2432) — instrumentation, telemetry, A/B pipeline
Experiment 2: Batching heuristics for short-turn chat (ENG-2470) — continuous batching config and load tests
Experiment 3: 8-bit quantization profiles (ENG-2405) — automated evals + canary rollout
Console: per-route cost toggles and rollout UI (DES-310)
Billing: reconcile cost attribution during experiment windows (ENG-2501)
metrics: Primary: per-token cost reduction on targeted routes (target: 20% aggregate across experiments)
Latency: P95 latency delta (target: <+5% for cache/batching; <+10% for quantization)
Quality: eval score delta on intent/answer accuracy (target: no >3% drop in evaluation suite)
Adoption: number of routes moved to optimized config (target: 50 routes by 2026-05-01)
ROI: estimated monthly cost savings compared to baseline (target: $300k/month by Q3)
notes: Keep experiment windows short (2 weeks) and require automated rollback if quality or latency thresholds exceeded
Coordinate customer communication for any dedicated-pool A/B tests that may affect response determinism
Plan a stakeholder demo after first-week results to decide on cycle 2026-W12 rollouts
